scripts.//env: Target an environment. Default is dev, so plain `npm test` is unchanged.
scripts.//gate: Release gate: every @blocker scenario. Run this against a release candidate.
scripts.//known-bugs: Regression guards for still-open defects. Failures here are expected.
scripts.//demo: Curated, all-tabs, reliably-passing set for a headed demo recording.
scripts.demo: cross-env TEST_ENV=staging ALLOW_WRITE_TESTS=true playwright test e2e/Onboarding/testSignup.spec.ts e2e/Programs/testProgramsList.spec.ts e2e/Programs/testCreateProgram.spec.ts e2e/Campaigns/testCampaignCreate.spec.ts e2e/Creatives/testCreativesList.spec.ts e2e/Creatives/testAddBanner.spec.ts e2e/Coupons/testCouponCreate.spec.ts e2e/Programs/testProductFeed.spec.ts e2e/Publishers/testPublisherActions.spec.ts e2e/Settings/testSettingsActions.spec.ts e2e/Reporting/testReportingGaps.spec.ts e2e/Navigation/testRemainingTabsSmoke.spec.ts --project=chromium --headed --workers=1 --retries=2 --grep-invert "Advertiser Setup" --reporter=list
scripts.//demo:trace: Same demo set, recording a trace for Cypress-like time-travel playback (open with `npm run report`).
scripts.demo:trace: cross-env TEST_ENV=staging ALLOW_WRITE_TESTS=true playwright test e2e/Onboarding/testSignup.spec.ts e2e/Programs/testProgramsList.spec.ts e2e/Programs/testCreateProgram.spec.ts e2e/Campaigns/testCampaignCreate.spec.ts e2e/Creatives/testCreativesList.spec.ts e2e/Creatives/testAddBanner.spec.ts e2e/Coupons/testCouponCreate.spec.ts e2e/Programs/testProductFeed.spec.ts e2e/Publishers/testPublisherActions.spec.ts e2e/Settings/testSettingsActions.spec.ts e2e/Reporting/testReportingGaps.spec.ts e2e/Navigation/testRemainingTabsSmoke.spec.ts --project=chromium --headed --workers=1 --retries=2 --trace on --grep-invert "Advertiser Setup" --reporter=list,html
scripts.//demo:ui: UI Mode on staging/chromium. Run in YOUR OWN terminal (interactive). Filter to demo specs inside the UI.
scripts.//demo:video: Single continuous advertiser-flow video (headed). Output: test-results/Demo-*/video.webm
scripts.demo:video: cross-env TEST_ENV=staging ALLOW_WRITE_TESTS=true playwright test e2e/Demo/demoFlow.spec.ts --project=chromium --headed --workers=1
